rules.rule: Plain natural read; never slowed or over-directed; stress at most 1 word per 3-4 sentences
Characters front-facing only (the approved HD cast); no side or 3/4 views
Zero visual glitches: no flicker, torn text or jumps between frames
Every video argues one clear thesis with our own calculation or comparison; never a reworded article
Open on the mystery or stake in the first 15 s; never a channel greeting
About 70% evergreen (explainers, lists, guides, comparisons, case studies), 30% trending; news reactions kept rare
One big emotional subject, 2-4 huge words that add tension (never repeat the title), readable at phone size
No background music; voice plus light SFX, final mix -14 LUFS
Numbers read off a chart are labelled approximate on screen; plot only sourced points, never invented in-between values
All on-screen text must read on a phone: slide body text 30 px+, no tiny caps sub-lines
No shot holds still for more than ~5 s; add a build, a prop or a cut
Show our own maths exactly as in facts.json (same inputs, same rounding)
Illustrate what the voice says: every sentence gets at least one visual that depicts its words (a vignette, an object, a scene action) — pose changes and generic icons do not count
Characters act inside scenes (sit, hold, interact, two-person moments) instead of standing beside them; props rest on surfaces or in hands, never float; frames as bright as the Alux reference (~15%)
At most ~3 keyword slams per video, saved for the real payoff lines

feedback.note: Not bad but could be improved a lot. Show more illustrations of what the voiceover is speaking — we don't show enough.
